gen-gf-oxanium-gf-ruda: Oxanium stands tall and commanding, its big lowercase and wire-smooth strokes leaving curves open to daylight. And Ruda follows in a friendly sans with a similar thin-line skeleton, so the two feel drawn from the same spool.
gen-almendra-display-poppins: Poppins reads modern and crisp, its loose curves and sturdy tall lowercase running without any thick-thin flicker. But Almendra Display brings the ornate, literary flavor above it, with letters that never pinch shut.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-vend-sans: Expressive and commanding, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes that never let the c tips drift toward touching. Vend Sans then carries a longer read in a ruler-straight sans whose tall lowercase fills each line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-tiktok-sans: Commanding is Goldman's whole manner, with widely set letters and round forms that curve like open parentheses. TikTok Sans takes the quieter job, a plain sans whose lowercase rises nearly to cap height.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-ubuntu-sans: Plain, constant-width lines with short ascenders and a tall x-height give Grandstander its bold, held-open look. Ubuntu Sans runs a longer stretch like bent copper pipe, with big-eyed lowercase and loops left pleasantly unfinished.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-yaldevi: Expressive and bold, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps ascenders low and strokes untapered, as if drawn with no quill pressure. And Yaldevi, a plain sans with outsized lowercase and an e that opens to the right, carries a longer read without strain.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-saira: Gugi's lowercase climbs nearly to the capitals, with cut-open terminals and full-width joins where hairlines might have been. And Saira carries a longer read in a clean sans, its see-through s and tall rounded letters moving along without fuss.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch reads approachable and compact, with a clearly open e and a short gap up to the ascender line. But Metamorphous is the one to make a statement, with generous sidebearings and a gentle fat-slim stroke that keeps paragraphs comfortable.
gen-gf-offside-gf-savate: Expressive and widely tracked, Offside draws single-weight curves that refuse to close. Savate follows with a sans-serif that has gentle stroke modulation, open jaws on every curve and a tall round o, so a longer read stays easy on the eye.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Oxanium leads with a smooth drawn-wire feel and a big lowercase. Schibsted Grotesk sits beside it in a friendlier voice, its tall-bowled e and a staying open, so the stiff monoline above feels softened rather than set against it.
